deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next scheduling housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference, re-anchored after the issue-filter-wiring cycle additively grew spec.md.
description: Doc-surface line counts of scheduling. The prior wave slimmed docs/spec.md to 871 lines; the FT-E loop-redesign reconciliation re-anchored it to 900; the self-healing known-port adapter-map migration re-anchored it to 936; the issue/PR-named dispatch-description cycle re-anchored spec.md to 944; the stale/incompatible tick-checkpoint discard-and-fresh cycle re-anchored spec.md to 983; the per_item dispatch-description-always-names-the-ref cycle re-anchored spec.md to 993; the advisory-REVIEW always_ok cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1008; the immediate-refire cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1069; the pool-based-refire + integrate/refire-observability cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1090; the §3.11.5 loopback opt-out PULL wiring cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1103; the file-referenced dispatch prompt cycle re-anchored spec.md to 1138; the remove-self-deploy-action cycle additively re-anchored spec.md to 1173; the remove-IMPLEMENT-harness-isolation cycle (a real behavior cycle, #335) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1181; the read-shipped-default-config-fresh cycle (a real behavior cycle: run_tick reads the shipped default-config/{route,adapter-map}.json FRESH else the embedded constant, and start.py's seed_default_config seed-once copy is retired, #337) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1195; the measured per-fix-rationale slim (#345) tightened redundant/restated rationale and decorative parenthetical prose WITHOUT dropping any load-bearing token, reducing spec.md to 1151; the wire-cumulative-GATE cycle (a real behavior cycle: pre-map the GATE port to run_tick:make_gate, delegate make_gate to verify_integrate.make_gate, and seed the gate_results read product when GATE is routed) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1157; the IMPLEMENT-template-task cycle (a real behavior cycle: the IMPLEMENT agent template carries a non-empty task + an opened output_example, and _build_agent_entry threads the template task onto dispatch['task']) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1169; the issue-filter-wiring cycle (a real behavior cycle: make_pull threads sg.issue_filter(runtime['governance']) into wi.Pull(issue_filter=...), mirroring the work_own_filings threading) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1183; the richer-status cycle (a real behavior cycle: status.py exposes a machine-first status_data() + a derived render_status(data) human view emphasizing the plugin version and listing the active route's states + happy-path chain, resolved via a shared run_tick helper) additively re-anchored spec.md to 1209 (contract.md keeps its 96-line baseline under the still-active strictly-grew gate). The housekeep e2e test asserts the current docs are NOT larger than these re-anchored baselines and that the load-bearing tokens survived. The historical pre-wave spec baseline (commit 7a42f9c) was 871; FT-E was 900.
